children: Blackstone Real Estate Income Trust's third-quarter revenue declined year over year, while its net loss narrowed. Lower rental revenue, largely from property dispositions, and higher real estate impairments weighed on results; gains from unconsolidated entities and interest rate derivatives, along with lower net interest expense, partly offset those pressures.
¹ Reported as “Total revenues”. ² Reported as “Net loss attributable to BREIT stockholders”.
: Sold 65 rental housing properties, nine industrial properties and one office property for $2.0B in net proceeds; recognized $366.1M in net gains.
: Recorded $496.7M in real estate impairment charges, including $453.7M on held-and-used properties and $43.0M on held-for-sale investments.
: Same Property NOI attributable to BREIT stockholders rose 5% to $1.2B, with higher rental and hospitality revenue.
: Deployed $3.4B (at BREIT’s share) into QTS data center development; developments were 100% pre-leased, in substantially all cases to investment-grade tenants.
: At September 30, 2026, portfolio occupancy was 94%; data centers were 100% occupied and industrial properties were 94% occupied.
